# obsidian-out (generated vault)

**Do not edit anything in this folder except `architecture/`.** It is regenerated from the sources on every sync:

- `docs/list-task-project.md` → `Board.md`, `Home.md`, `tasks/`
- `agent-history/entries/*.json` → `Agent Log.md`, `history/`
- `docs/**`, `README_AI_AGENT.md` → read-only mirrors of the docs pack (`docs/_archive/` excluded)
- graphify (`graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md`) → `graph/GRAPH_REPORT.md`
- `architecture/` is hand-written and kept by the sync (edit it here)

## Use it

1. `bun run obsidian:sync` (or `bun run obsidian:watch` for a live board)
2. Obsidian → Open folder as vault → this folder
3. Install and enable the community plugin **Kanban**, then open `Board.md`

To move a card, change its `status:` line in `docs/list-task-project.md`, not the board.

Only this README is committed; everything else here is ignored by git. Full guide: [docs/integrated-obsidian-local.md](../docs/integrated-obsidian-local.md).
